entry_points.text: Byte queue allocator forwards size element size and flags to node aware allocation with no affinity as default placement.

exports.text: Small inline checksum adapters compute storage integrity and ethernet CRCs over caller bytes from fixed seeds and report no acceleration in this configuration.
Character predicates test table masks for alnum alpha graph print punct space and hex, with digit octal checks and ASCII case shifts guarded by class.
Object debugging calls are inert here: lifecycle operations do nothing observable and activation reports success without work.
Bitmap helpers find next nth first or last matches over boolean combinations, wrap circularly, and iterate bits and runs; absent matches yield length.
Pool wrappers add virtual ranges with or without physical backing, allocate with placement choice and owner, free, and return null for device tree lookup here.
Integer hashing multiplies by golden ratio constants keeping high bits with word size folding, plus byte string and short word entry points.
Hash helpers size buckets by bit count, init heads, insert at head by hashed key, test membership and emptiness, and remove with regular and RCU paths.
Identifier maps and small allocators offer static definition, empty initialization, and ranged allocation over an underlying tree or extensible array.
One generator yields typed insert remove and overlap search over a cached red black root using caller supplied node and bound accessors.
Queues provide static and dynamic setup, single typed put get peek with barriers, bulk in out, skip, and next record length inspection.
List and object accessors expose static init, stored names, enclosing set conversion with null tolerance, reference get put, and type lookup.
String parsers convert decimal and prefixed bases to long and 32 bit signed and unsigned results with mandatory status checking.

hazards.text: Reset skip DMA finish and linear peek mutate or expose indices without locking or bounds checks; over advance fabricates occupancy and division truncates partial elements.
Attribute permission and constness rely on compile time selection with divergent builds via external helpers; list validation coverage varies by debug config.
Regular RCU and safe traversals do not substitute for each other; cursors use single access; static queue sizes must be power of two; inline versus delegated paths depend on size.

invariants.text: Empty buckets lack a first link, unlinked nodes lack predecessor, unlink rewires neighbours and optionally clears, leaving cleared nodes untouched.
Identifier maps are empty only with no tree head and free tag; allocator emptiness means no array head.
Word hashing absorbs blocks into three accumulators with mixing, folds tails by position, then avalanches with result from the third.
Capacity is mask plus one with power of two sizing; occupancy is producer minus consumer with masked indexing, barriers, and record header accounting.
Empty doubly linked heads self reference next and previous; guarded heads annotate the protecting lock for analysis.

locks.text: Scoped guard macros bind a holder whose constructor acquires the chosen lock and whose cleanup destructor releases it, with conditional success tracking.
Identifier maps reuse the embedded tree lock with plain and interrupt state saving pairs plus a preload reservation release.
Queue wrappers serialize emptiness checks and bulk moves with a caller lock, with interrupt saving and plain forms.

state_machines.text: Tracking states order none initialized inactive active destroyed not available with a count bound; transitions are not shown.
Full walks advance bucket index from zero to size visiting each bucket in order; RCU and safe forms keep the outer walk.
Identifier scans start from a caller index fetching next present entries with monotonic progress and resuming shapes.
Lifecycle events order add remove change move online offline bind unbind from zero with remove as terminal withdrawal.

structs.text: Tracking record holds hash link, ordered state, extra numeric state, object or batch tail pointer choice, and callback descriptor pointer.
Pool holds lock chunk list minimum order placement callback opaque data and name; chunks track space addresses owner and trailing bitmap.
Fixed ABI numbers cover CRC accel flags 1 2 4, polys 0xedb88320 0x04c11db7 0x82f63b78, eight ctype bit masks, and 32 and 64 bit golden ratio multipliers.
Tables are two to the bits arrays of hash heads; identifier maps store tree root base and hint, allocators wrap an array with 128 byte chunks and free tag zero.
Interval nodes store red black link inclusive start last and subtree maximum; span state tracks cursor nodes ranges and hole marker; hashing uses size mask and deadbeef seed.
Queue headers store positions mask element size and data pointer with inline pointer and record views; counted lists hold lock head callbacks nodes and iterators.
Objects embed name hierarchy type sysfs refcount and lifecycle flags; sets group members with lock and ops; events use fixed buffer and namespace callbacks with one valid type.
